name: guitool-tabs-server
description: Tiny read-only file-server exposing a shared folder of Guitar Pro tab files (.gp/.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gp7/.gpx) as a list+download REST API for Guitool's Songs → Tabs page. Deliberately minimal — one dependency (Express) plus built-in CORS headers, no auth/database, meant to run as an internal Docker service on a home network or LAN, not exposed to the public internet.
